text:
Clara: quick RFC follow-up — proposing a thin handshake proxy as the canonical handoff surface across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. idea: the proxy only does a capability ping, preserves trace/request ids, and forwards routing hints. no mutation, no local key material.

Ben: short +1. two blockers we must document: private HSM header injection and exact streaming parity for customers relying on chunk boundaries.

Yara: for HSMs we keep an operator-managed injector (helm + example manifest). the proxy exposes an allowlist header so the operator component can inject post-auth. do not store secrets in the proxy.

Leo: streaming parity plan: capture representative streams (goldens) and run a binary chunk-diff. add the tool to the harness and fail canary if diffs observed. also validate chunk timing for backpressure-sensitive clients.

Clara: rollout phases suggested:
- alpha: hosted internal tenants (ff on)
- canary: hosted public (2w baseline)
- opt-in: dedicated (exclude HSM-bound)
- private: operator install + migration window
- GA: flip default after 90 days stable
And include an LB-level kill-switch to rebind traffic to the legacy facade if needed.

Ben: parity metrics: run three workloads (short-chat <=128t, long-context >=8k, and embeddings) at 3 tps buckets (100/500/1500) for 30m each. collect P50/P95/P99, error taxonomy, token cost per request, and streaming-latency-per-chunk. gate: p95 regression <3% and no new 5xx classes.

Yara: add quality checks: sample 1k production prompts; for deterministic routes assert token-for-token equality, else compute cosine similarity of embeddings or n-gram similarity. also check tokenization ID sequences when possible.

Leo: config drift prevention: manifest-lint rule that warns about facade-only keys and a Dedicated preflight that blocks flips when such keys exist. surface warnings in the provisioning UI.

Clara: compatibility handshake example: HTTP GET /_capabilities -> 200 {"capabilities":["stream:framed","kv:v2"],"probe":true}. proxy will refuse incompatible runtimes and either route to legacy facade or return 409 with a migration-hint header.

Ben: KV pointers are scary mid-flip. plan: maintain legacy facade for flagged tenants until a background reconciler migrates KV indices. require a pre-flip snapshot and reconciliation verification. ops must certify snapshots before GA.

ops-bot: created jobs: handoff-baseline-184444 (cadence=daily), handoff-snapshot-184444 (retention=30d). link: https://ci.redwood/handoff/184444

Yara: security note: operator install docs must be reviewed by security (HSM patterns). tagging @security-team in the PR.

Clara: CI plan: prototype (7d) -> harness + streaming diff (5d) -> hosted alpha (2w) -> hosted canary (2w) -> dedicated opt-ins (3w) -> private operator migration docs (2w) -> GA flip after 12w monitoring. include a kill-switch runbook and dashboard templates.

Ben: please include exact header names to preserve (traceparent, X-Redwood-Req-Id, x-rw-route-hint) and the debug header (x-rw-proxy-debug) that is only emitted during canaries.

Yara: QA: add a CI job that runs the golden stream diff and the tokenization equivalence checks before any canary move. qa-bot: create job?

qa-bot: scheduled job: probe-proxy-parity-184444 (cadence=pre-canary). link: https://ci.redwood/qa/probe-proxy-parity-184444

Leo: ops approved for tempo. I'll own LB kill-switch and snapshot verification. ping me on PRs.

Clara: I'll draft the rollout playbook, manifest-lint spec, operator helm snippet, and the harness README with the streaming-diff tool. will ping this thread for review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
